operating_notes.text: Company is diversifying into critical and strategic minerals including Phosphorite and Limestone.
Company signed MoU with NPCIL for development of nuclear power projects through a JV
Signed MoU with IIT(ISM) TEXMiN for critical and strategic mineral exploration and research.
Annual coal production from Talabira II & III OCP reached 19.14 MT in FY26.
Incorporated JV named NIRL NCRTC Renewables Limited with NCRTC with 74:26 equity participation for solar PV projects.
Issued and allotted 3,000 Commercial Papers of face value ₹500,000 each aggregating ₹150 Cr on 20 July 2026.
Wholly owned subsidiary NLC India Renewables Limited received LoI from GUVNL for a 900 MW solar power project awarded under tariff-based competitive bidding.
Wholly owned subsidiary NLC India Renewables Limited received an LoA from SECI to develop a 200 MW wind power project in Koppal, Karnataka and supply power to SECI.
India Ratings assigned IND AAA/Stable to ₹1,102 Cr bank loans, and affirmed IND AAA/Stable on ₹2,500 Cr NCDs, IND A1+ on ₹6,000 Cr CPs, and IND AAA/Stable/IND A1+ on ₹2,923 Cr bank loans.
Received notices from BSE and NSE imposing fines of ₹14,31,340 (incl. GST) each for non-compliance with board and committee composition norms; sought waiver citing appointment powers rest with GoI.
NIRL (wholly owned subsidiary) and NCRTC formed 74:26 JV NIRL NCRTC Renewables Limited (NNRL) and signed 25-year captive PPA for 110 MW UP solar plant (180 MU annual requirement, 24-month execution).
Received LOI for grant of Composite Licence from Government of Telangana for Govindpur and Parvathapur Vanadium, Titanium & Aluminous Laterite blocks.
Wholly owned arm NIRL incorporated a 51:49 JV named NIRL OREDA RENEWABLES LIMITED with OREDA for setting up green energy power plants.
CRISIL reaffirmed CRISIL AAA/Stable rating on ₹9,140.44 Cr bank facilities (reduced from ₹10,334.7 Cr) and ₹2,500 Cr NCDs on 3 September 2026.
Signed addendum to BTA to hive off 708.96 MW of RE assets (including 4 MW Green Hydrogen) to wholly owned subsidiary NIRL at book value within 3 months.
Wholly owned arm NIRL received LoI from GUVNL for developing a 275 MW / 550 MWh Standalone Battery Energy Storage System in Gujarat under tariff-based competitive bidding.
Board approved borrowing of unsecured USD 100 million ECB from Punjab National Bank for thermal, mining and diversification capex.
Subsidiary NIRL received LoA from SJVN Limited for 200 MW ISTS-connected wind power project under tariff-based competitive bidding.
Subsidiary NIRL incorporated a 74:26 joint venture company named NIRL PTC RENEWABLES LIMITED with PTC India Limited for green energy projects across India.
Allotted 10,000 Commercial Papers of face value ₹5,00,000 each aggregating to ₹500 Cr.
Board approved incorporation of a 50:50 JV with NALCO (proposed name NLC NALCO Power Limited) for a 1,080 MW (4 X 270 MW) thermal captive power plant.
FY26 coal production reached 19.14 MT and dispatch reached 17.69 MT from Talabira-II & III OCP, generating 2.26 BU of green energy.
Operational milestones include coal production at Pachwara South Coal Mine, commercial operation of three 660 MW units at NUPPL Ghatampur, and renewable portfolio reaching 1,785 MW.
Subsidiary NIRL received LOA from SJVN for 265 MW/530 MWh Standalone BESS in Haryana at ₹2,35,000 per MW per month capacity charge under VGF.
Issued and allotted 20,000 commercial papers of face value ₹5,00,000 each aggregating to ₹1,000 Cr on 12 October 2026.
Subsidiary NIRL received LOA from WBSEDCL for 50 MW/200 MWh Standalone BESS project at Arambag, Hooghly, West Bengal.
Signed MoUs with IPICOL for a 3,200 MW ultra super-critical thermal power plant (₹35,000 Cr outlay), a beach sand mineral processing facility (₹2,000 Cr), and a coal gasification project in Odisha.

timeline.summary: NLC India was granted composite licences for the Semhardih and Raipura Phosphorite & Limestone Blocks in Chhattisgarh for geological exploration.
The Board noted stock exchange fines for Q3FY26 non-compliance with SEBI board composition rules and requested the Ministry of Coal to appoint Independent Directors.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹5,042.46 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹1,393.46 Cr.
2026-05-25: NLC India signs MoU with NPCIL for development of nuclear power projects through a JV
On 26 May 2026, NLC India signed an MoU with IIT(ISM) TEXMiN for critical and strategic mineral exploration and research.
On 27 May 2026, NLC India Renewables incorporated a 74:26 solar JV named NIRL NCRTC Renewables Limited with NCRTC.
Government of India’s Promoter, via Under Secretary Pradeep Raj Nayan, confirmed no encumbrance of NLC India Limited shares during FY2026.
Government of India to sell 2.00-3.00% of NLC India via OFS, worth ₹860-1,290 Cr at the floor price.
Allotted ₹150 Cr in commercial paper (3,000 units of ₹5 lakh face value) on 20 July 2026.
NLC India arm NIRL received an LoI from GUVNL to set up a 900 MW solar power project via competitive bidding.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,716.75 Cr (+23.3% YoY), net profit ₹436.33 Cr (-48.0% YoY).
Renewables subsidiary received an LoA from SECI for a 200 MW wind power project in Koppal, Karnataka.
India Ratings assigned IND AAA/Stable to ₹1,102 Cr bank loans and affirmed AAA/A1+ ratings on ₹11,423 Cr existing facilities.
BSE and NSE imposed fines of ₹14.31 lakh each on NLC India for non-compliance with board and committee composition rules; company sought a waiver.
Executed 25-year captive solar PPA vi JV NNRL with NCRTC for a 110 MW project in UP generating 180 MU annually.
Received LOI from Government of Telangana for Composite Licences in Govindpur and Parvathapur critical mineral blocks.
NLC India subsidiary NIRL incorporated 51:49 green energy JV NIRL OREDA RENEWABLES LIMITED with OREDA.
CRISIL reaffirmed AAA/Stable ratings on NLC India's ₹9,140.44 Cr bank facilities (reduced from ₹10,334.7 Cr) and ₹2,500 Cr NCDs.
Signed addendum to BTA to hive off 708.96 MW of renewable energy assets to wholly owned arm NIRL at book value.
Subsidiary NIRL received LoI from GUVNL for a 275 MW / 550 MWh standalone BESS project in Gujarat.
Board approved USD 100 million unsecured ECB from PNB for capex and fixed 22 September 2026 as record date for FY26 final dividend.
Subsidiary NIRL received LoA from SJVN Limited for development of a 200 MW ISTS-connected wind power project.
Subsidiary NIRL incorporated a 74:26 renewable energy JV, NIRL PTC Renewables Limited, with PTC India Limited.
NLC India issued and allotted ₹500 Cr of Commercial Paper on 22 September 2026.
Board approved 50:50 joint venture with NALCO to develop a phased 1,080 MW thermal captive power plant.
At 70th AGM, NLC India announced total dividend of 38.5% (~₹533.86 Cr) for FY26 and outlined Vision 2047 target of 20 GW power and 100 MTPA mining capacity.
NLC India arm won LOA from SJVN for 265 MW/530 MWh standalone BESS in Haryana at ₹2.35 lakh/MW/month under VGF.
NLC India Limited’s 70th AGM held on September 29, 2026, passed all resolutions via e-voting and physical attendance under Chairman & MD Prasanna Kumar Acharya.
Allotted 20,000 commercial papers aggregating to ₹1,000 Cr on 12 October 2026.
2026-10-14: NLC India's subsidiary NIRL received LOA from WBSEDCL for 50 MW/200 MWh standalone BESS project in West Bengal
On 22 October 2026, NLC India announced signing MoUs with IPICOL for a 3,200 MW thermal power plant in Odisha involving ₹35,000 Cr investment.
